deadlines.dateText: Applications can be submitted from 1 December for the following academic year. They are reviewed on a rolling basis until the Admission Board has selected a cohort of 30 students. As places are limited, early application is strongly recommended. For non-European applicants, the recommended deadline is 30 May due to visa processing times, while the deadline for European applicants is 31 July.
